name: Dispel Magic

targets.description: one creature, object, or magical effect

upcast.text: A spell on the target ends automatically if its level is no higher than the slot level you use.

summary: End every spell of level 3 or lower on a target; higher spells need a check against DC 10 + spell level.
text: Choose one creature, object or magical effect within 120 feet. Every ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on it, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability against DC 10 + that spell's level; on a success, that spell ends. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: any spell on the target whose level is equal to or lower than the slot level you use ends automatically.
